name: QuickQuote
tagline: Price a driveway job on your phone, in the driveway.
before: The estimate gets worked out on paper or in your head, then typed up again at night. Prices drift from job to job and the customer waits a day for a number.
after: Pick the service, enter the measurements, and get a clean quote with your own prices while you are still standing in the driveway. Concrete, asphalt, gravel, pavers and sealing.
privacy_note: Your prices, business details and quote history stay in your own browser. Nothing is sent to us.
origin: Built first for Seals Go Pro, a driveway sealing business. Type your own business name in Settings.
built_with: One web page, built with AI. Works on a phone.
